shapeSummary: Single barrel-shaped roller, 40 mm long along Z and 20 mm max diameter. It is made by revolving a profile with a 7 mm end radius bulging to a 10 mm radius at mid-length, with an 8 mm through bore on the axis. The axis runs along Z at Y=10, so the bottom sits at Y=0 and X and Z are centered.
warnings: No dimensions are given, so the 40 mm length, 20 mm max diameter, 14 mm end diameter and 8 mm bore are estimates.
The barrel curvature is an assumed circular arc.
The surface bump texture is omitted.
The pack's other 43 rollers, the pin, 2 bearings, 12 E-clips and 12 shims are not modeled.
The axis is along Z as in the analysis, so the part is centered at Y=10 to satisfy the bottom-at-Y=0 rule.
